review.why: Gets content cited and recommended in AI answers: visibility audit, extractable structure, authority, bot access and agent-readable files.
review.summary: Explains how AI answer engines choose sources, separates Google's stated guidance from the other engines, and walks through an audit: test key prompts across assistants, compare citations, check extractability and crawler access. It then covers structure, authority, presence, machine-readable files such as llms.txt, and monitoring; sixteen references are routed by question.
strengths: States Google's own position and treats other engines separately
Warns not to forecast from vendor percentages; AI answers are sampled repeatedly because they vary
Separates being cited from being recommended
cautions: Fast-moving field: many figures come from dated vendor studies
Sixteen reference files are not read here
Files like llms.txt or a pricing file have no confirmed ranking effect, as it admits
